confidence_rule.HIGH: complete candidate list, OBSERVED evidence level, exact frame, STRONG or SUPPORTED subject link
confidence_rule.MEDIUM: complete candidate list, OBSERVED evidence level, exact frame, weaker subject link
confidence_rule.LOW: complete candidate list but derived evidence or a weak anchor

ordering_rule: exact frame number only; ties with different provenance stay ambiguous
candidate_universe_rule: a truncated candidate list blocks any earliest-boundary claim
not_confirmed: the selected boundary is a first observed abnormality, not a root cause
no network function is identified as responsible
downstream observations are ordered after the boundary and are not attributed to it
procedure or service success is not established by the absence of a boundary
user-plane forwarding is not established by any control-plane boundary
subscriber, subscription or implementation behaviour is not assessed
